reasons: Depends on hand-picked run ids and on a measurement comment that must be updated by hand.
The lessons check is weaker than the scan check.
The test script named in the header was not visible, so the check's behaviour is only confirmed by reading.

sections.name: File setup, DEMO_SCOPE
sections.title: Pinned industry and the reasons for choosing
sections.what: Sets the LNG industry as the demo scope and records, in a long comment, why two saved runs were chosen and the measurements behind each choice.
sections.why: The comment records the reasoning so a later reader can judge the choice. Reason for the detailed history not stated in the code beyond the comment.
sections.watch_out: The comment figures describe a point in time. If the runs are rerun, the comment goes stale.

sections.name: DEMO_PINS
sections.title: Recorded run identifiers
sections.what: Holds the identifiers of the scan run and the lessons run that the demos replay, each with a short reason.
sections.why: Fixed ids make the demo show the same saved result every time.
sections.watch_out: If either run is deleted, every demo that uses it reports a missing run.

sections.name: DEMO_EVIDENCE_PROJECT_PATTERNS, DemoTool
sections.title: Preferred evidence projects and tool names
sections.what: Lists LNG project name patterns preferred for the example evidence, and defines the two demo tool names.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code. The list is not used inside this file.
sections.watch_out: The patterns use percent wildcards in the style of database matching, so they match by name prefix.

sections.name: PinCheck
sections.title: Shape of the check result
sections.what: Defines the fields the check returns: pass or fail, run id and date, problems found, project ids, the Yard project count and any changed values.
sections.why: A fixed shape lets the demo screens show the same information for both tools.
sections.watch_out: The changed values list must be kept in step with the fields the check actually compares.

sections.name: SCAN_FIELDS
sections.title: Scan fields compared with project data
sections.what: Maps each stored scan field to the matching column in the project table, such as status, country and planned budget.
sections.why: The check needs to know which saved values to compare with current data.
sections.watch_out: If a project column is renamed, the type check on this map flags it.

sections.name: same
sections.title: Comparing two values loosely
sections.what: Decides whether a recorded value and a current value count as the same. Blanks are treated as equal and numbers are compared by value.
sections.why: Stored and live data can differ in format, such as a number versus its text form.
sections.watch_out: Text is compared after trimming spaces, but letter case still matters.

sections.name: sameScope
sections.title: Checking the run's scope
sections.what: Confirms that a saved run covers exactly the LNG industry and nothing narrower.
sections.why: A run limited to some projects would make the demo misleading.
sections.watch_out: Only the industry list is compared. Extra or reordered fields are not checked.

sections.name: setDiff
sections.title: Finding items missing from a list
sections.what: Returns the items in the first list that are not in the second.
sections.why: Used to spot projects added to or removed from the project data since the run was made.
sections.watch_out: Only one direction is checked per call, so both directions need two calls.

sections.name: checkDemoPin
sections.title: Checking a pinned run is still valid
sections.what: Runs the full check for the scan or lessons run. It confirms the run exists and succeeded and covers only LNG. For scan it compares stored values with current data. For lessons it confirms acceptance and a slide deck. It then compares project sets and reports every problem found.
sections.why: The demos must not show a saved result that no longer matches the live project data.
sections.watch_out: The lessons branch does not compare values, and a missing run returns early, so later checks are skipped.

summary: Chooses the two saved LNG runs that the guided demos replay, and checks that they still match the current project data.
purpose: Fixes which Reality Scan run and which Lessons Learnt run the demos show, and provides a check that reports whether those runs are still valid.
why: The comments say selection is explicit and never automatic, so the demos tell one consistent LNG story. The long comment records why each run was chosen and the measurements behind it.
how: It names the LNG industry as the scope and fixes two run ids. The check function loads each run, confirms its status, scope and accepted results, compares the project list and stored values with current project data, then reports ok only when no problems are found.
inputs: The database tables for scan and lessons runs and their stage results, the current project data (called the Yard in the code), and the scope resolver.
outputs: The pinned ids and labels, and a check result that says whether the pin is ok, lists problems, project ids and any changed values.
risks: The run ids are fixed by hand, so deleting or changing those runs makes the demos fail. The lessons check compares project lists and acceptance, but not values.
debug: Run the check for the tool that misbehaves and read the problems list first. A changed value message means project data was edited after the run was saved. The header names script/test-demo-cohorts.ts as the runner, which was not in this packet.
